mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, description, location, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time FROM department WHERE status = 1 AND type = 'CLINICAL' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT doc.id, doc.department_id, doc.name, doc.title, doc.gender, doc.avatar, doc.intro, doc.status, doc.create_time, doc.update_time, dep.name AS department_name, reviews.rating, COALESCE(reviews.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(visits.consult_count, 0) AS consult_count FROM doctor doc JOIN department dep ON dep.id = doc.department_id AND dep.status = 1 AND dep.type = 'CLINICAL' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT doctor_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM appointment_review GROUP BY doctor_id ) reviews ON reviews.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.doctor_id, COUNT(*) AS consult_count FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE a.status = 'completed' GROUP BY s.doctor_id ) visits ON visits.doctor_id = doc.id WHERE doc.status = 1 AND doc.role_type = 'DOCTOR'
AND doc.department_id = #{departmentId}
AND (doc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dep.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY doc.id ASC

SELECT doc.id, doc.department_id, doc.name, doc.title, doc.gender, doc.avatar, doc.intro, doc.status, doc.create_time, doc.update_time, dep.name AS department_name, reviews.rating, COALESCE(reviews.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(visits.consult_count, 0) AS consult_count FROM doctor doc JOIN department dep ON dep.id = doc.department_id AND dep.status = 1 AND dep.type = 'CLINICAL' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT doctor_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM appointment_review GROUP BY doctor_id ) reviews ON reviews.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.doctor_id, COUNT(*) AS consult_count FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE a.status = 'completed' GROUP BY s.doctor_id ) visits ON visits.doctor_id = doc.id WHERE doc.id = #{id} AND doc.status = 1 AND doc.role_type = 'DOCTOR'
mapper.sql: s.id, s.doctor_id, s.schedule_date, s.time_slot, s.total_quota, s.booked_count, GREATEST(s.total_quota - s.booked_count, 0) AS remain_quota, s.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM schedule s JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = s.doctor_id AND doc.status = 1 AND doc.role_type = 'DOCTOR' JOIN department dep ON dep.id = doc.department_id AND dep.status = 1 AND dep.type = 'CLINICAL' WHERE s.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND s.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.time_slot ASC, s.id ASC
mapper.sql: a.id, a.schedule_id, a.patient_name, a.patient_phone, a.id_card, a.amount, a.pay_method, a.pay_time, CASE WHEN a.status = 'pending_pickup' THEN 'pending_rx_pay' ELSE a.status END AS status, a.remark, a.create_time, a.update_time, s.schedule_date, s.time_slot, doc.id AS doctor_id, doc.name AS doctor_name, doc.title AS doctor_title, dep.id AS department_id, dep.name AS department_name, p.id AS prescription_id, p.status AS prescription_status, p.total_amount AS prescription_amount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM consultation_record cr WHERE cr.appointment_id = a.id ) AS has_consultation, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM appointment_review ar WHERE ar.appointment_id = a.id AND ar.user_id = a.user_id ) AS evaluated
mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointment a JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = s.doctor_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id = doc.department_id LEFT JOIN prescription p ON p.id = ( SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM prescription p2 WHERE p2.appointment_id = a.id AND p2.user_id = a.user_id ) WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT cr.id, cr.appointment_id, cr.doctor_id, cr.chief_complaint, cr.present_illness, cr.diagnosis, cr.treatment_plan, cr.doctor_advice, cr.create_time, cr.update_time FROM consultation_record cr JOIN appointment a ON a.id = cr.appointment_id WHERE cr.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cr.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, appointment_id, user_id, doctor_id, total_amount, status, pay_method, pay_time, create_time, update_time FROM prescription WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, prescription_id, medicine_id, medicine_name, spec, dosage, frequency, days, quantity, unit_price, amount FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY medicine_id ASC, id ASC
